crossRefs.note: You have loved righteousness, and hated wickedness. Therefore God, your God, has anointed you with the oil of gladness…
For he whom God has sent speaks the words of God; for God gives the Spirit without measure.
You have an anointing from the Holy One, and you all have knowledge.

translations.web: The priest shall take some of the log of oil, and pour it into the palm of his own left hand.
translations.bsb: Then the priest shall take some of the log of olive oil, pour it into his left palm,
translations.kjv: And the priest shall take some of the log of oil, and pour it into the palm of his own left hand:
translations.asv: And the priest shall take of the log of oil, and pour it into the palm of his own left hand;
